snippet.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The die has been cast... Lost in Random: The Eternal Die is coming to all platforms on June 17! 

Step back into the gothic fairytale world of Random, where an ancient evil awaits. Play as Queen Aleksandra and her loyal die-companion, Fortune, in this fast-paced action-roguelite where you'll battle nightmarish foes, wield powerful relics and abilities, and roll the dice to face the dark force threatening everything - Mare the Knight.

Pre-order the Fortune Edition today to play early on June 13 and be among the first to experience this dark fantasy adventure! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564520/Lost_in_Random_The_Eternal_Die/ 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/lost-in-random-the-eternal-die/9n72g399183f 
Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011792/ 

Free demo now available on Steam and Xbox! Full release coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and PC on June 17.
